The issuer shows moderate profitability (EBIT margin ~22% and net margin ~9%), supporting its ability to generate earnings. However, leverage is relatively high (liabilities ~76% of assets, with equity ~24% of assets) and liquidity is weak (current ratio ~0.72), which increases refinancing and near-term obligations risk. Overall this aligns with a speculative grade in the lower BB range.  
DECISION: BB-
